capabilities.justification: Reads weakness registry JSON, package manifests, and assurance reports.
Discovers source and artifact files in target package directories.
Emits generated assurance reports to target package directories.
Emits verification verdicts and report diagnostics to stdout.
Reads CLI invocation arguments via std::env::args.
Signals exit status codes via std::process::exit.

justification: Verification gate tool that audits packages against the weakness registry and emits assurance reports.
